Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro phone sync — timezone check & calendar swap

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for applying to the Engineer, Inference position. I’d love to schedule a 25-minute phone screen to learn more about your background and share a bit about the role. Below are a few windows I have this coming week (all shown in PDT):

• Tuesday 6/15 — 10:00–11:00 AM or 3:00–4:00 PM
• Wednesday 6/16 — 8:30–10:00 AM
• Thursday 6/17 — 12:00–2:00 PM

If none of those work, tell me the three 30-minute blocks that do work for you (include your timezone) and I’ll convert and send an invite. Also: do you prefer Zoom or phone? I’ll include a calendar invite once we lock a time.

I attached a provisional .ics (redwood-recruiter-screen.ics) with the earliest slot in case it helps with quick booking.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Recruiter — Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Li <hannah.li+recruiting@gmail.com>

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 13:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Intro phone sync — timezone check & calendar swap

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the quick note. I’m currently in London (BST, UTC+1). The Tuesday/Wednesday windows in PDT look tricky given the offset, but I can do:

• Wed 6/16 — 16:30–17:00 BST (which I believe is 08:30–09:00 PDT)
• Thu 6/17 — 18:00–18:30 BST (10:00–10:30 PDT)

If those map cleanly to your slots, either works for me. Zoom is fine. I attached my availability as an .ics export — you’ll see the blocked times from my calendar (hannah-availability.ics).

Also: I prefer a short pre-read about the team. Is there a one-pager or tech overview I can skim?

Cheers,
Hannah Li
hannah.li+recruiting@gmail.com

Scheduled:
• Wed, 16 Jun 2026, 08:30–08:55 PDT / 16:30–16:55 BST — 25 minutes
Location: Zoom (link below)
Calendar: attached (redwood-recruiter-screen.ics) — please accept or let me know if you’d like a different time.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (placeholder — actual link in calendar)

Irene — copying you so you have the invite on your calendar. We intend this to be a screening conversation focused on background, system design instincts around inference runtimes, and interest in production-serving tradeoffs. No prep required beyond a quick look at the team one-pager (link below).

One-pager: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExample (team brief)

Quick ask for Hannah: if possible, bring one example of a latency/throughput tradeoff you worked on — just a high-level 2–3 minute story.

Thanks both —
